title: Windows Update Script Settings
description: Configuration file for windows-update.ps1 script (automated Windows Update management)

schedule.runMonth: Array of month names (e.g. 'January', 'June') to run updates. Empty array = every month.
schedule.runWeekday: Array of weekday names (e.g. 'Wednesday', 'Sunday') to run updates. Empty array = every day.
schedule.runTime: Array of UTC times in HH:mm format when updates should run.
schedule.minIntervalMinutes: Minimum minutes between update runs to prevent duplicate executions.

_comments.updateCategories: Set to 'all' to install all updates regardless of category, or provide an array of specific categories. Available categories: 'Critical Updates', 'Security Updates', 'Definition Updates', 'Update Rollups', 'Updates', 'Feature Packs', 'Service Packs', 'Tools', 'Drivers', 'Upgrades'

exclusions.kbNumbers: Array of KB numbers to exclude (e.g. 'KB5034441')
exclusions.titlePatterns: Array of wildcard patterns to exclude by title (e.g. '*Preview*', '*Optional*')

preChecks.minDiskSpaceGB: Minimum free disk space in GB required before installing updates
preChecks.checkPendingReboot: Check if system has pending reboot from previous updates

options.rebootBehavior: Reboot behavior: 'never' (abort if reboot needed), 'manual' (continue, user reboots later), 'auto' (reboot automatically after delay)
options.rebootDelayMinutes: Minutes to wait before auto-reboot when rebootBehavior is 'auto' (0 = immediate)
options.dryRun: Simulate update installation without making changes

reporting.generateReport: Generate text report after update installation
reporting.emailNotification: Send email notification after updates (requires emailSettings)

emailSettings.smtpPort: SMTP port (typically 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL, 25 for plain)
emailSettings.credentialEnvVar: Machine-level environment variable containing Base64('username:password'). Empty for no auth.
